attribution.note: Marcus states this in his own commentary about his essay.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the application qualifier and investment figure. The tentative language concerns the essay's explanatory value, not the asserted difficulties.

contract.note: The practical-benefits reading is ordinary and preserves the limited quantifier. Using 2024 as the latest completed reporting year is reasonable, though evaluator-selected. Investment boundaries remain unspecified and materially affect verification.

evidence.note: Reported 2024 benefits falling below expectations provide limited support for difficulties realizing intended benefits. Organization-level results do not establish application failures or the investment total.

Successful selected advanced initiatives constrain a broad failure interpretation but can coexist with difficulties in many applications. The survey also reports continuing scaling and value-creation challenges.

Available before evaluation and documenting 2024, this report measures annual private funding. That narrower metric cannot establish or contradict cumulative industry investment including possible infrastructure spending.

reviews.rationale: The surveys offer qualified evidence of unrealized benefits alongside successful deployments, without establishing representative application outcomes. No comparable cumulative accounting verifies or refutes approximately $500 billion invested by publication. The packet therefore does not settle the combined claim.
